labelMapping.text: Dose tiers follow pinned author-code convention; prefix-to-metabolite names are curated abbreviation interpretations of Table S1. S1 does not contain S3 label strings, and no PCC 7942 layout establishes the full correspondence. These are candidate condition assignments, not verified sample-level joins.

contrast.text: The study reports treatment/control comparisons. Code subtracts the first GROUP level; the PCC 7942 layout is unavailable, so S3 log2FC polarity is not established. Preserve signed values without interpreting positive as activation or protection.

assay.material: Desalted cell extract from pooled cultivations
assay.metaboliteAddition: In vitro addition to extract; not an intracellular concentration or live-cell treatment
assay.scope: Proteinase K limited proteolysis; not cultivation temperature or metabolite preincubation time

control.text: Buffer added instead of metabolite; not a measured zero endogenous metabolite concentration

assay.where: Article Methods Sec9-Sec11; Results Assessment of LiP-SMap method and data
assay.replicateScope: Prepared design only. Analyzed technical n is not available per S3 comparison; source screening required peptide detection in at least three replicates per group and removed outliers.

record.conditionSet: PCC 7942 LiP-SMap comparison; candidate dose assignment
record.samples: Source S3 comparison labels; no sample/run pairing inferred

citation.text: Sporre E, Karlsen J, Schriever K, et al. Metabolite interactions in the bacterial Calvin cycle and implications for flux regulation. Communications Biology 6, 947 (2023).

replicates.text: Independent biological n and analyzed technical n per S3 comparison are not established. Four source cultivations were pooled before harvest; the prepared design used four technical aliquots per group sharing one extract. Peptides required detection in at least three replicates per group; outliers were removed and abnormal experiments repeated. Two 10 mM glyoxylate runs are described, but S3 Glyx_2 run identity is not established. BioReplicate=1 is not a biological n.

treatments: In vitro metabolite addition to pooled extract followed by limited proteolysis

temperature.text: PCC 7942 cultivation temperature not stated; 25 °C describes proteolysis only

lightIntensity.text: Approximately 70 µmol photons m⁻² s⁻¹ during cultivation; separate 400 pre-freezing exposure
